title: Vintage Super Bowl 38 Hat Cap Strapback Black Panthers Patriots NFL 2004 Houston
descriptionText: Show off your love for the Black Panthers and the NFL with this vintage Super Bowl 38 hat. The adjustable strapback design ensures a comfortable fit for any head size. The black color and patriotic theme make this cap a stylish addition to any outfit. Perfect for men who want to add a touch of sporty flair to their wardrobe, this Reebok brand baseball cap is a must-have accessory.
